query.name: com.unorth.teacher_grade_analytics.teacher_sections_by_email
query.description: Returns sections assigned to one teacher matched by exact school email.
query.sql: SELECT USERS.DCID, USERS.FIRST_NAME, USERS.LAST_NAME, USERS.EMAIL_ADDR, SCHOOLSTAFF.ID, SECTIONS.ID, SECTIONS.COURSE_NUMBER, SECTIONS.ROOM, SECTIONS.EXPRESSION, COURSES.COURSE_NAME FROM USERS JOIN SCHOOLSTAFF ON SCHOOLSTAFF.USERS_DCID = USERS.DCID JOIN SECTIONS ON SECTIONS.TEACHER = SCHOOLSTAFF.ID LEFT JOIN COURSES ON COURSES.COURSE_NUMBER = SECTIONS.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE LOWER(USERS.EMAIL_ADDR) = LOWER(:teacher_email) ORDER BY SECTIONS.COURSE_NUMBER, SECTIONS.EXPRESSION, SECTIONS.ID

query.name: com.unorth.teacher_grade_analytics.section_roster_by_id
query.description: Returns roster identity fields for one section. Used only after the section has been discovered for the authenticated teacher.
query.sql: SELECT CC.SECTIONID, CC.DATEENROLLED, CC.DATELEFT, STUDENTS.ID, STUDENTS.DCID, STUDENTS.STUDENT_NUMBER, STUDENTS.FIRST_NAME, STUDENTS.LAST_NAME, STUDENTS.ENROLL_STATUS FROM CC JOIN STUDENTS ON STUDENTS.ID = CC.STUDENTID WHERE CC.SECTIONID = :section_id ORDER BY STUDENTS.LAST_NAME, STUDENTS.FIRST_NAME, STUDENTS.STUDENT_NUMBER
